notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check; evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. Model-authored and unreviewed: the R2 hardware backend is refused until reviewed_by is set, and the hardware path in native.py was never run. The package models one RLHT heater slice through openreactor.rlht:RlhtSlice (one of the card's entry symbols); the hardware factory starts the slice and runs the upstream Controller poll so the command watchdog is fed, but that path is untested. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the package is a direct decorated Driver over RlhtSlice rather than the PythonObjectDriver helper, because the two setpoint writers must round to the slice's tenth of a degree and the e-stop and safe-state action must call the same native send_safe. NOT COVERED: the EZO sensor DriverPort reads and calibration, the Service run/recording/API actions, DCMT motors, and the RLHT PID/period/thermocouple configuration writes; no line of the clone documents an independent hardware e-stop, so SAFE-045 is met with the safe-state action and estop_physical_ref is not set. The setpoint limit 0 to 3276.7 Cel is the slice maximum when the config sets no max_setpoint; site-limits.example.json is an example that only narrows it to 90 Cel. All numbers in fake.py are placeholders, not facts. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
